linux done (B1b-31): 26 second-order themes, 25 placed with 16 rule 0 lines (41 placements), 1 bag (t11 kept in T3-021, T3-005, T3-055 and T3-146 bagged), 1 unplaced (t26, a bare reply 'No' to Save Tux); no new kind. t04: members' Linux-themed fakes in T3-001, the Libreboot developer's own renaming joke in T3-048. Episodes: new E1304 (the Cow Chop logo's overlap with Tux's white space and the help defending Tux), E1305 (the GNU/Linux sign and Tux with Arch logos beside them, the plus turned into a slash, a shared bot map and the red dot in Tux's eye, seven members in both rooms; the records differ on why the plus became a slash), E1306 (the LOST numbers under Tux and Linux's refusal to overwrite them), E1307 (red squares on the Leafs logo traced into r/linux by one member, h9.58 to h9.96; the records differ on the culprit); joined E839 (the Swedish flag pressing the Arch logo, h41.14 to h47.90) and E1048 (the truce over the Tragedy's letters, h25.49). Not episodes: mylittlepony (greetings with the pony neighbours, c0051 and c0073; nothing of Linux there); paladins (an r/Paladins apology for a blue square, c0090; nothing of Linux there); rust (the Rust maintenance botnet offered, c0117; rust's record holds nothing of Tux); factorio (c0107; factorio c0178 brings a tile placer found on r/linux at h53.46, another matter); pcmasterrace (c0074; nothing of Linux there); croatia (croatia c0062, c0107 and c0171 say its work ended up on r/linux and a member maintains the penguin; r/linux's record names nothing of Croatia); EraseThePlace (c0004 at h9.88; EraseThePlace c0306 'TUX LIVES' at h74.31); earthbound and fireemblem (named only). Outside the census: linuxmasterrace, windows. Political content named plainly: griefers turning the GNU+Linux plus into a swastika, undone by watchers, and the slash adopted so it could not be done. For B1d: t04 T3-095 (c0025, c0026 and c0028, the Debian announcement worked out, if Debian staged it); t07 T3-086 (c0070, GNU+Linux against GNU/Linux); t08 T3-070 (c0022, the browser addon); t11 T3-087 (c0134), T3-040 (c0035) and T3-011 (c0100); t12 T3-040 (c0090 and c0091) and T3-045 (c0053).
